page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4.16xlarge is a local storage instance type built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processors based on the x86_64 architecture, running at a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz across 64 dedicated vCPUs. The instance is configured with 512.0 GB of memory, yielding a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

Storage configuration includes 15,358 GB of integrated local solid-state drives, eliminating external network dependencies for disk input and output operations. Networking throughput is defined by a 50 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The system configuration includes no graphics processing units (0 GPUs) and does not allocate complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dense pairing of 512 GB RAM and over 15 TB of direct-attached solid-state storage delivers high capacity for I/O-intensive and data-heavy operations. The architectural tradeoff centers on the ephemeral nature of direct-attached local storage, which requires operational data replication at the software layer. This hardware profile is appropriate for distributed NoSQL databases, search indexing engines, in-memory caches, and high-throughput transactional storage systems.
